localDelivery.title: Local delivery
localDelivery.description: Plan and assign local delivery routes. Visualize orders on a map, tag them to routes, and organize efficient delivery zones for your customers.

retailSales.title: Retail sales
retailSales.description: Set monthly sales targets by location and track actual performance. Monitor KPIs, rankings, and goal completion across all your stores.

footprintExpansion.title: Footprint expansion
footprintExpansion.description: Identify the best retail locations to expand into. Rank potential spots by customer proximity and estimated revenue impact.

priceTags.title: Price tags
priceTags.description: Automatically assign discount labels to products based on price reductions. Configure metaobject-based tags and discount tiers.

storytelling.title: Story-telling
storytelling.description: Generate SEO-optimized blog content using AI. Create content briefs, review AI drafts, and publish directly to your Shopify blog.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure delivery locations, Lalamove dispatch settings, carrier services, and shipping rates for your store.

productLaunches.title: Product launches
productLaunches.description: Track revenue and unit goals for new product launches. Compare results against benchmarks and segment by tag, location, or channel.

uiElements.title: UI elements
uiElements.description: Browse interactive examples of Polaris web components used throughout this app. Useful for development reference and testing.
